target.title: feat(apps): add native mobile Automations parity
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The web Control UI can manage scheduled gateway work, while the native mobile apps exposed only a partial cron surface. iOS lacked safe detail/edit/history/run/delete controls, and both mobile platforms lacked practical search and status filtering.

Closes #106145.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Use the existing `cron.*` gateway contract; no new protocol or config surface.
- Add mobile-appropriate management parity while keeping creation, cloning, and dense delivery/failure-routing editing in the Control UI.
- Preserve optimistic-concurrency safety with `expectedConfigRevision` and fail closed when the connected gateway changes.
- Track queued runs by exact `runId`, paginate the complete automation list, and preserve unsaved drafts.
- Fold in the outstanding native Skills review fixes from #105814.

## User Impact

- iOS and Android now call the feature **Automations**.
- Both apps support search plus All / Active / Paused filters.
- iOS adds configuration detail, recent history, revision-safe editing, enable/pause, Run Now tracking, and confirmed deletion.
- Android retains its existing management surface with the same product naming and discovery controls.
- Create/clone and advanced delivery/failure routing remain available in the web Control UI.

## Evidence

- Android focused unit tests: Cron management/runtime, Settings filters, and Skills management.
- iOS focused tests: 10 Automations model/revision/pagination/outcome tests passed on iPhone 17 Pro / iOS 26.5.
- OpenClawKit focused tests: 9 Skills management tests passed.
- Native screenshot XCUITests: Automations and Skills screens passed on iPhone 17 Pro / iOS 26.5.
- Android source-blind behavior pass: navigation, search empty state, Active/Paused filtering, detail configuration, and management actions.
- Native localization: 4,482 source entries synchronized across all 21 locale artifacts.
- Screenshots posted below.
